objective: Add a real owner-only Vision scene-QA workflow that lets the owner rate each successful or abstained screen description as correct, partial or incorrect and observe bounded per-provider/model acceptance metrics without persisting pixels, summaries or conversation data.
non_goals: Do not claim the M08 scene-QA or Companion Gate B has passed from synthetic tests or fewer than the owner-approved sample set.
Do not persist raw images, Vision summaries, prompts, API keys, chat text or owner corrections.
Do not enable automatic capture, decision support, game control, training or model promotion.
Do not change Vision inference, confidence scoring, text brain, STT, TTS or VRAM budgets.
Do not run soak, repeated deep workflow or real Cloud/model benchmark.
contracts: Only an owner.desktop request with ownerConfirmed=true may create or replace a rating for a registered Vision observation.

The bounded ledger stores only observation UUID, provider/model profile, ready-or-abstained state, uncalibrated confidence and categorical rating; it never stores pixels, summaries, prompts, labels, chat text, API keys or corrections.
Ratings are correct, partial or incorrect; rerating the same observation replaces the previous rating instead of inflating the sample count.

Dashboard metrics are scoped to the currently configured provider/model, stay in RAM until runtime restart, cap retained candidates at 100 and clearly distinguish a session candidate score from final scene-QA promotion.
The UI exposes three plain-language rating buttons only for a real ready or abstained capture result and reports rated count, weighted score, target and minimum sample guidance.
Vision result confidence/abstention, fifteen-second fresh context, capture consent, archive behavior and decisionSupportEligible=false remain unchanged.
allowed_dependencies: Python standard library, existing Vue/TypeScript/Electron stack and existing repository test tooling.
acceptance_criteria: A ready or abstained observation is registered without storing its summary and can be rated once or rerated through the owner-only route.
Unknown, invalid, unregistered, non-owner or unconfirmed ratings fail closed and do not change counters.
Per-profile aggregate counts and weighted score are deterministic, bounded and reset only with the runtime process.
Desktop typed IPC reaches only the fixed loopback review route and the renderer cannot supply source or ownerConfirmed fields.
PerceptionPage shows usable Đúng/Thiếu/Sai controls and session progress without claiming the ≥85% release gate is complete.
Perception/core route tests, desktop typecheck/build/tests, module-brief validation and git diff check pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M08-S24-owner-vision-scene-qa-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s workers/perception/tests -p "test_*.py"
uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s apps/core-runtime/tests -p "test_perception_routes.py"
